description: UI modernization pass - Batch 3: Tasks, Calendar, Activity pages. Apply the premium design system. Only change CSS classes - no logic/structure changes.
steps: In src/routes/_authenticated/tasks.tsx: (1) Change page container from 'p-4 md:p-8' to 'p-5 md:p-10'. (2) On stats strip filter buttons (rounded-xl border p-3), add 'shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (3) On task items (flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border p-4), add 'hover:shadow-md hover:scale-[1.01] transition-all duration-200 ease-out' (keep existing conditional classes). (4) On 'New Task' Button, add 'transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (5) On priority badges, add 'rounded-full'. (6) On the Card wrapping loading/empty states, add 'shadow-sm'. (7) On the delete Button (ghost variant), add 'transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (8) On Select triggers within task items, add 'transition-all duration-200 ease-out'.

In src/routes/_authenticated/calendar.tsx: (1) Change page container from 'p-4 md:p-8' to 'p-5 md:p-10'. (2) On the calendar Card and right panel Cards, add 'shadow-sm'. (3) On navigation Buttons (ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Today), add 'transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (4) On day cell items (rounded-lg border), change to 'rounded-xl' and add 'hover:shadow-sm transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (5) On calendar day buttons, add 'transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (6) On the selected day tasks/followup/payment items, the 'rounded-lg border' should become 'rounded-xl border hover:shadow-sm transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (7) On Badges, add 'rounded-full'. (8) The quick-add '+' button should have 'transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (9) Make legend Card have 'shadow-sm'.

In src/routes/_authenticated/activity.tsx: (1) Change page container from 'p-4 md:p-8' to 'p-5 md:p-10'. (2) On the Card wrapping activity feed, add 'shadow-sm'. (3) On each activity item (p-4 flex gap-3 hover:bg-muted/30), change to 'p-4 flex gap-3 rounded-xl hover:bg-accent/20 hover:shadow-sm transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (4) On the icon circles (size-9 rounded-full), add 'shadow-sm'. (5) On search Input, add 'focus:ring-2 ring-primary/20 transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (6) On Badge (variant outline for lead link), add 'rounded-full transition-all duration-200 ease-out hover:shadow-sm'. (7) Make the timestamp text use 'text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/70'.
acceptance_criteria: Running `bun run build` completes successfully with no TypeScript errors
Tasks page items have hover:shadow-md + scale[1.01] transitions, rounded-full priority badges
Calendar page has shadow-sm cards, rounded-xl day items with hover effects
Activity page items have rounded-xl with hover:shadow-sm transitions
